literal: Goodness of mind well though they possess, to the noble, goodness of association protection possesses.
translation: Even if the noble possess great goodness of mind, it is the goodness of their association that provides them with true protection.
modern: சான்றோர்கள் மனநலத்தை மிக நன்றாகப் பெற்றிருந்தாலும், அவர்களுக்கு அவர்கள் சேரும் இனத்தின் நலமே சிறந்த பாதுகாப்பைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the vital importance of keeping good company, even for those who are already wise and pure of mind. While individual goodness of mind (மனநலம்) is highly valuable, it is the goodness of one's association (இனநலம்) that acts as a secure fortress or protection (ஏமாப்பு) against external influences and downfalls. The word 'ஏமாப்பு' means protection or strength, highlighting that even the virtuous need a supportive environment to maintain their virtue. Thus, the company we keep reinforces and safeguards our inherent goodness.
